svg.title: SliDR: match the change from one slice to the next
svg.desc: Adjacent CT slices from AMOS amos_0212, with matched input and MedVTok reconstruction. The animation advances both stacks and their signed slice differences together, through slices 108 to 112. Blue and pink encode opposite directions of intensity change. All input and reconstructed difference maps use the same symmetric scale of 201.00 HU, based on the input's 99th percentile absolute change across these frames, computed before display windowing. Static mode shows slices 108 and 109. This first-difference example illustrates structural fidelity, not every loss term or an ablation comparison.
